items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: As a matter of fact while we were performing for Jimmy Carter I guess it was

ctx.x: And I met Artie Shaw, I knew Artie Shaw a little you know. I never told him but I believe with that sort of thing you’ve got to tell people. So it was clarinet. And her name was List, I forget his first name, Mr. List I called him. Very nice man. He was sort of like the violin teacher , slight, pale, very musical. I don’t know what he played. But he was a very good teacher in that he taught me fingerings. I mean to this day, you know, the high notes and everything. You know like really correct. The alternates,…
